preconditions.description: The number of jewelry pieces n is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of colors k used is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.
The output consists of k followed by n space-separated integers representing the colors.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(color) <= int(stdout.split()[0]) for color in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each color assigned to a piece of jewelry is between 1 and k inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) != int(stdout.split()[j]) for i in range(1, len(stdout.split())) for j in range(i + 1, len(stdout.split())) if (i + 1) % (j + 1) == 0 and is_prime(j + 1))
postconditions.description: No two pieces of jewelry have the same color if the price of one piece is a prime divisor of the price of the other piece.
